title: Prepare Dactyl as Decapod's datastore replacement boundary
intent: Extend dactyl-db into a first-class backend-neutral datastore boundary capable of replacing Decapod's direct SQLite/rusqlite needs without modifying Decapod: expose connection-scoped operations, parameterized queries, transactions, stable row projections, runtime and compile-time SQL analysis, inline datastore directives, and adapter-independent proof.
stop_conditions: Do not modify /home/arx/src/decapod or expose rusqlite types from dactyl's public contract
